name: Easy Google Maps by Supsystic – Custom Markers, Clustering & Map Themes
author: supsystic

sections.description:
Easy Google Maps by Supsystic adds interactive Google Maps to any WordPress page: unlimited maps and markers, custom marker icons, marker categories with a filter, clustering and map themes. Describe every location with text, photos, video, links, phone and e-mail, then publish the map with a block, an Elementor widget or a shortcode. No code required.

The plugin works with your own Google Maps API key, and the settings page walks you through getting one in a couple of minutes. It supports the current Google Maps JavaScript API, including Cloud Map IDs and Advanced Markers.

Unlimited maps and markers

  • Markers with text, photos, video, links, phone and e-mail
  • Custom marker icons from the built-in library or your own image
  • Marker categories with a front-end filter
  • Marker clustering for maps with many locations
  • Linked markers that open any URL on click
  • Address search: type an address and get the pin

Map settings

  • Roadmap, satellite, hybrid and terrain map types
  • Width, height, zoom, minimum and maximum zoom
  • Scroll-wheel and drag behaviour
  • Responsive maps with a separate zoom level on mobile
  • A starter set of map themes
  • Map language and region (US, CA, GB, DE and more), so labels and address search match your country
  • Google Maps China endpoint (maps.google.cn)

Add maps anywhere

  • Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, sidebar widget, shortcode and PHP snippet
  • Works with WPBakery, Divi, Beaver Builder and other page builders through the shortcode

Import and export

Move maps and markers between sites with CSV import and export.

Made for

  • Contact page and office location maps
  • Businesses with several branches, stores or dealers
  • Real estate and rental listings
  • Restaurants, hotels and event venues
  • Travel blogs and city guides

Translations

The plugin ships with translations in 15 languages.

Prefer maps without a Google API key?

Try Ultimate Maps by Supsystic for OpenStreetMap and Leaflet maps. It can import your Easy Google Maps maps.

Easy Google Maps Pro

Pro adds directions, layers and richer ways to present your locations:

  • Route builder: connect several points, choose the travel mode and let Google find the optimal order of stops, or set your own order
  • Get Direction button, routes with turn-by-turn steps and alternate routes, starting from the visitor’s position
  • KML layers with filters, and KML points imported as markers
  • Traffic, transit and bicycling layers and a heatmap layer
  • Figures: polygons, polylines and circles
  • Table view and photo or description sliders for your locations
  • Visitors can add or edit markers from the front end
  • Centre the map on the visitor’s location and a places search toolbar
  • Fullscreen and print buttons, custom control positions and hidden labels
  • Static map images, social sharing and markers shown between two dates
  • The full collection of map themes

Learn more

  • Official plugin page
  • Pro features
  • Pricing
  • Documentation
  • How to create a Google Maps API key
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New Plugin and search for “Easy Google Maps”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open the Easy Google Maps settings and add your Google Maps API key. It takes a couple of minutes; a step-by-step guide is linked under Learn more.
  4. Add a new map, then add markers by typing an address or clicking on the map, and save.
  5. Add the map to a page with the block, the Elementor widget or the shortcode.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Maps API key?

Yes. Google requires an API key to display its maps. It takes a couple of minutes to create one; a step-by-step guide is linked under Learn more.

Does Google charge for maps?

Google Maps Platform includes free monthly usage, and many small sites stay within it. Check Google’s current pricing for your expected traffic.

Does it support Cloud Map IDs and Advanced Markers?

Yes. Add your Map ID in the map settings and markers render as Advanced Markers. Maps without a Map ID keep working as before. When a Map ID is set, Google controls the map style through Cloud Styling.

How many maps and markers can I add?

As many as you need. Maps and markers are unlimited in the free plugin.

Can I use my own marker icons?

Yes. Choose an icon from the built-in library or upload your own image.

Can visitors filter markers by category?

Yes. Assign markers to categories and show a front-end filter on the map.

Does it support marker clustering?

Yes. Nearby markers group into clusters that open as visitors zoom in.

How do I add a map to a page or post?

Use the plugin’s block in the block editor, the Elementor widget, the sidebar widget, or paste the map shortcode. A PHP snippet is available for theme templates.

Can I show my map in another language or for China?

Yes. Set the map language and region in the settings, and switch to the Google Maps China endpoint if your visitors are in mainland China.

Can I build a route through several points?

Yes, with Pro. Add waypoints with descriptions, pick the travel mode and choose whether Google optimises the order of stops for the shortest trip or keeps your order. The route follows the roads and shows turn-by-turn steps.

Can I show directions to a location?

Yes, with Pro: a Get Direction button on every marker, routes with turn-by-turn steps, alternate routes and a start from the visitor’s current position.

Can I move maps to another site?

Yes. Export maps and markers to CSV and import them on the other site.

Is there a version that works without Google?

Yes. Ultimate Maps by Supsystic uses OpenStreetMap and Leaflet without a Google API key and can import your Easy Google Maps maps.

How can I report a security issue?

Please report security issues through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team validates and triages each report and notifies us.
sections.changelog:
2026

1.16.1 — October 30, 2026

  • Tested up to 7.1.4 – General code improvements.

1.16.0 — October 26, 2026

  • Added Excel-friendly CSV: exported files open correctly in Excel, and Excel files (UTF-8 with BOM, Windows-1251/1252, “,” or “;” delimiter) can be imported.
  • CSV import now explains why rows were skipped and ignores empty rows.
  • Fixed CSV import of maps creating duplicates instead of updating existing maps.
  • Fixed CSV export and import losing map options.
  • Fixed CSV import adding backslashes before apostrophes and losing marker categories and Excel dates.
  • Fixed saving a map while PRO is deactivated erasing its PRO settings.
  • Fixed “Clear All” in Marker Categories doing nothing.
  • Fixed case-sensitive category search and category font size levels that could not be cleared.
  • Fixed markers from old versions missing from category filters.
  • Fixed missing default marker icons on new sites.
  • Fixed manual marker order being reset in the map editor.
  • Fixed marker search in the map editor.
  • Fixed marker hover titles not showing.
  • Fixed info windows not showing when “Hide marker tooltip” is on.
  • Fixed the “Hide info window close button” option with the current Google Maps API.
  • Fixed maps staying draggable when dragging is turned off.
  • Hiding the zoom control now also hides Google’s new camera control.
  • Fixed the map widget missing in Appearance → Widgets.
  • Shortcode and widget width now accept “%” and “px”.
  • Fixed several shortcodes of the same map with different parameters on one page.
  • Fixed map cloning losing marker categories and display periods.
  • Fixed PRO options in the free version looking enabled after the upgrade notice.
  • Fixed the “Display period for the markers” tooltip text.
  • Security: admin actions without a valid nonce are rejected, and generic actions no longer run for modules that do not support them.
  • Accessibility: list checkboxes and icons keep their screen reader labels.
  • Fixed PHP 8.1+ warnings and deprecation notices.

1.15.4 — October 16, 2026

  • Maintenance release with minor stability improvements.

1.15.3 — October 15, 2026

  • General security hardening and code improvements.

1.15.2 — October 9, 2026

  • Maintenance release with minor stability improvements.

1.15.1 — September 29, 2026

  • Maintenance release with minor stability improvements.

1.15.0 / 24.09.2026

  • General security hardening
  • Added JSON export of map themes for Google Cloud styling when a Map ID is set
  • Fixed a grey map when no maximum zoom level is set
  • Fixed the CSV Import button not opening the file dialog
  • Removing maps, markers and marker categories now also removes their related data

1.14.6 / 08.09.2026

  • Added an optional API Region setting for Google Maps JavaScript API localization
  • Kept the Google Maps default region behavior when the API Region setting is empty

1.14.5 / 03.09.2026

  • Added Elementor and Gutenberg map selection integrations
  • Improved the classic WordPress widget with shared map selection fields and sanitized settings
  • Improved frontend map initialization in dynamic editor and page builder contexts

  • General security hardening

1.14.3 / 14.08.2026

  • Fix Custom Map Controls and related admin toggles not working

1.14.2 / 10.08.2026

  • General security hardening and code improvements

1.14.1 / 10.08.2026

  • Server-side validation for the API Domain setting, enforced both when it is saved and when it is used to build the Google Maps script URL

1.14.0 / 10.08.2026

  • General security hardening and code improvements

1.13.1 / 07.08.2026

  • General code cleanup and stability improvements

1.13.0 / 31.07.2026

  • Added further security hardening and unofficial version detected
  • Fixed a critical error that could occur when saving markers on a newly created map
  • Fixed an issue where reordering marker groups (parent category) could silently fail to save
  • Completed a full compatibility pass for PHP 7.4 through 8.5 across the plugin core
  • General code cleanup and stability improvements

1.12.3 / 28.07.2026

  • Fixed: admin menu could stay hidden after activation on some installs (core module state is now self-healing)
  • Added: guided setup after activation – connect your Google Maps API key and jump straight into creating your first map
  • Updated: Overview page promo image
  • Minor fixes
